body:
## Why a separate A17 art experiment?
A14's added ribbon was REJECT. A15 looked like two sculpted cliffs. A16 is still pending independent final QA and visual judgement—**this PR does not presume A16 failed**. Test a much larger architectural discontinuity without overriding A5-A16 originals.

## Actual production
- Rebuild the persisted A13-C GLB and A15-B in a read-only research copy.
- Independently replace the two cliff envelopes in that new study only with two radically different **single-piece watertight, voxel-extracted volumetric megafolds**: A17-A Ascending Sky-Wound, A17-B Cascading Civic Caldera. These are not A16-style apertures/windows; each includes a genuinely empty, open-edged geological-scale cavity.
- Actual GLB and OBJ export, GLB reimport and volume checks, mandatory legacy 331/993 route and blocker checks (45 inherited body surface collisions are still unresolved).
- Same-camera A13-C/A15-B/A17-A/A17-B front/oblique/side/aerial panels, quantitative geometry QA, reproducibility provenance.
- Push-only path-scoped Actions CI with rebase-safe GitHub archival after **both** build and strict QA succeed. GH artifacts should not be called permanently saved until the archive job and actual repository file presence are confirmed.

## Critical limitations
**ART HOLD / NO MINECRAFT CONSTRUCTION / NO CITY INTEGRATION.** Preview of just the macro sculpture showed a slab-like field, not yet a convincingly inhabited city; it may be judged ART REJECT after full four-view comparison. Hosted city deck/new volume physical joints, structural transfer, upper free walking, egress, and safety are unverified. The two original cliff objects are omitted in **this new study copy only**, never modified in A5–A16 or any world. No gate relaxation.

## Separate ongoing job
A16 reference Actions run 40165116192 and A17 initial A/B build run are not to be claimed successful while queued. Completion requires reading run/job status, QA and archived assets, then independent art critique.
